The program is:
```dafny
method incrementArray(a:array<int>)
  requires a.Length > 0
  ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < a.Length ==> a[i] == old(a[i]) + 1
  modifies a
{
  var j : int := 0;
  while(j < a.Length)
    invariant 0 <= j <= a.Length
    invariant forall i :: j <= i < (a.Length) - 1 ==> a[i] == old(a[i])
    invariant forall i :: 0 <= i < j ==> a[i] == old(a[i]) + 1
    decreases a.Length - j     
  {
    assert forall i :: 0 <= i < j ==> a[i] == old(a[i]) + 1;
    assert a[j] == old(a[j]);
    a[j] := a[j] + 1;
    assert forall i :: 0 <= i < j ==> a[i] == old(a[i]) + 1;
    assert a[j] == old(a[j]) + 1;
    j := j+1;   
  }
}
```

The error is at line 14, column 4, which is `assert a[j] == old(a[j]);`

The counterexample says: a.Length = 2, a[1] = 7719, j = 0.

So at the point where j = 0, we need to prove `a[0] == old(a[0])`.

The second invariant is: `forall i :: j <= i < (a.Length) - 1 ==> a[i] == old(a[i])`

When j = 0 and a.Length = 2:
- The invariant says: `forall i :: 0 <= i < 1 ==> a[i] == old(a[i])`
- This means: `0 <= 0 < 1 ==> a[0] == old(a[0])`
- This gives us `a[0] == old(a[0])` ✓

`forall i :: 0 <= i < 1 ==> a[i] == old(a[i])`
